rationale: 835 denies both lines CO-29/N211 as untimely. But the 277CA for trace TRC75364521 is dated 2025-01-27, eight days after the 2025-01-19 DOS, with no A3/A7 rejection — the claim was submitted and acknowledged well inside any commercial filing window.
